title: Service request procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of user plane resources and signaling connection.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where it is registered with the 5G network.

entities.name: User plane established
entities.description: Property indicating successful establishment of user plane resources.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure includes receiving SERVICE ACCEPT message.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
SERVICE ACCEPT message establishes user plane resources.
